methodology.purpose: Historical calibration of mechanical Screener/Discovery setup/regime/sector skeleton plus V1.2 next-day execution research; NOT historical full V3.3.
methodology.priceBasis: Yahoo OHLC scaled by Adj Close/Close; unadjusted volume
methodology.rrProxy: Exploratory only: nearest MA20/prior10Low - 0.25 ATR vs prior60High; never production V3.3 R/R
methodology.extensionResearch: All liquid stocks meeting existing EXTENDED definition, not capped by Discovery's daily extended quota.
methodology.executionResearch: Signal generated after close; execution starts next trading day with four standardized entry styles, 1.5ATR/structure stop, 2R target and 5-day time exit.

knownBiases: SURVIVORSHIP_BIAS: current security master; delisted historical names absent
Yahoo/yfinance is not official archival bulk data
Not a backfill of final V3.3 Opportunity or ChatGPT A/B/C decisions
Extension taxonomy and execution thresholds are hypothesis-driven diagnostics, not optimized production parameters
Daily OHLC creates intraday path ambiguity; V1.2 handles ambiguous stop/target ordering conservatively

taxonomy.STRONG_CONTINUATION: Close position >=70%, RVOL20 >=1.15, positive RS20, sector strength >=65, and positive MA20 slope or return20 >5%.
taxonomy.EXHAUSTION_RISK: Weak close (<=40%) or large upper wick/range with weak close.
taxonomy.OTHER_EXTENSION: Extended by daily gain or MA20 distance without the above primary pattern.
taxonomy.note: Flags overlap. extensionSubtype is a priority label (exhaustion > strong continuation > gap > high-volume > other); use byFlag for orthogonal evidence.

calibrationPolicy.rule: Only consider changes consistent in 2024 train and 2025 validation; never tune on 2026+ test; confirm with forward Decision Ledger.

baseRule.entry: MA5 rising and close crosses above MA5 at close; enter next session open.
baseRule.normalExit: MA5 falling and close crosses below MA5 at close; exit next session open.
baseRule.selectionPriority: Higher MA5 slope, then higher signal-day trade value; max 5 concurrent positions.

stopRules.FIXED_STOP_5PCT: 5% below raw entry price; gap below stop exits at the open, otherwise intraday touch exits at stop.
stopRules.FIXED_STOP_7PCT: 7% below raw entry price; gap below stop exits at the open, otherwise intraday touch exits at stop.
stopRules.ATR_STRUCT_STOP: max(entry - 1.5*ATR14, prior10Low - 0.25*ATR14) when valid; static initial stop.

promotionPolicy.minimum: Prefer positive 2025 total return and expectancy, profit factor >1, materially lower drawdown and worst loss than MA5_ONLY, while retaining a strong payoff ratio and without excessive post-stop recoveries.
